title: Close pre-re-freeze 2n1t/o9bd follow-up beads in one PR
description: Supervisor parent for phase 2 (after PR #455 merges): drive to completion the follow-up beads created during the eshyra-2n1t and eshyra-o9bd work, at the same adversarial-review quality bar as PR #455, in a single PR off main.
